credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (CGI Moon Kit)

color.projection: equirectangular, centred on 0 deg longitude, +X east, north up
color.source: 2025 LROC WAC Hapke normalized mosaic colour map, 16-bit sRGB TIFF, 4k
color.note: NASA: this color map is optimized for aesthetics, not science. Scientific applications should use the source LROC WAC Hapke normalized mosaic.

normal.convention: tangent space, +X east, +Y north (three.js normalMap), centred on 0 deg longitude
normal.source: LOLA gridded elevation at 16 pixels per degree, float32 km relative to a 1737.4 km sphere
normal.method: block-average heights to output size, widen a longitude blur toward the poles, central differences on the sphere, normal = normalize(-dh/dx, -dh/dy, 1) with heights scaled by the exaggeration
normal.note: Visual relief only. The exaggeration makes this unfit for any measurement.

cap.projection: orthographic view of the unit sphere from the south pole in the globe's scene frame: u = x / cos(edge), v = z / cos(edge); row 0 is v = +1
cap.convention: object-space normals, RGB = n * 0.5 + 0.5, scene frame x = cos lat cos lon, y = sin lat, z = -cos lat sin lon
cap.source: LOLA PGDA product 90, south polar stereographic, 240 m, heights above the 1737.4 km sphere
cap.note: True-scale relief, lit live by the Sun in the app.
